text: A lab workbench scene built on grey aluminium extrusion framing. Centre-left: a dark grey plastic rack with multiple round wells sits in the frame; one well holds a clear tube with a bright orange screw cap, capped and upright, its lower body appearing dark. The other wells are empty. Behind, on a dark tabletop, a blue two-stage vacuum pump with silver ports stands upright, with a black cable running down toward the bench. Right: more extrusion columns, white metal brackets with bolts, and a black-framed screen or display panel. Foreground left: a white flat plate or tray with holes on the bench. A small white label with a logo is attached to a vertical rail at bottom centre.
